'''2009 US West Nationals Day 2 Kyle Krueger DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kyle Krueger]] at [[2009 US West Nationals]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Kyle
* '''Deck name:''' Unemployment
* '''Username:''' MeTO
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
